items.name: 01c-hero
items.prompt: A real small utility room in a British house: on the left a white ceramic Belfast sink on a sage base cabinet with a brass bridge tap; to its right a white front-loading washing machine and a white tumble dryer side by side under a continuous white oak worktop; sage green shaker wall cabinets above, an open shelf with woven baskets, terracotta floor tiles, a small window with daylight. The Belfast sink sits on its own base cabinet with its front apron exposed; the worktop runs up to both sides of the sink and stops at the sink, with nothing resting on top of the sink rim and no worktop overhanging into the bowl; the tap is mounted on the worktop or wall behind the sink and its spout is over the middle of the bowl. The washing machine has a round glass door and a detergent drawer; the tumble dryer is clearly different: a solid white round door with no glass window, no detergent drawer and a single simple dial. Plain unbranded appliances with blank control panels: no logos, no text, no numbers. Realistic proportions at true real-world scale (appliances about 60 cm wide and 85 cm tall under a 90 cm worktop). Shot like a real estate interior photo with a 24 mm lens at standing eye height, true-to-life materials, no CGI look. British home, no people, no text, no logos, square 1:1, high detail.
